source: تقدر تعملي ماب كوره 3d بملعب و نبس تلعب و تشوط كوره

image_prompt.text: Painted touchlines and goal lines marking the edge of the pitch
A centre circle and kickoff spot the ball is placed on to start play
A goal at each end of the pitch, open-mouthed and netted so a shot reads as a score
Pitch markings across the grass - halfway line, penalty areas, corner arcs
A football sitting on the centre spot, ready to be kicked

layout_placement.text: A detection perimeter on the touchlines so play can be reset when the ball leaves the pitch
Kickoff position at the centre spot for the ball and the players
A scoring volume inside each goal mouth that registers a shot going in

notes: The prompt asks only for a pitch you can run around and kick a ball on; everything beyond the pitch, the goals and the ball came from the preset.
No ball option exists in this genre, so the ball itself - the object the prompt is actually about - is carried as free text.

open_questions.ask: No look was given - should this be a clean grass stadium pitch, a dusty street pitch, or something stylized?
Is this a real match with two teams and a score, or just a pitch to mess about kicking a ball on?

coverage_missing.ask: Stadium grass, street pitch, or stylized?
Teams and a scoreline, or a free kick-about?
Full regulation pitch, or a small five-a-side court?

answers.ask: No look was given - should this be a clean grass stadium pitch, a dusty street pitch, or something stylized?
answers.answer: Make it a clean grass stadium pitch, with a simple 3D football field and goals.

answers.ask: Is this a real match with two teams and a score, or just a pitch to mess about kicking a ball on?
answers.answer: Just a pitch to mess about kicking the ball on; no teams, match rules, or score system are needed.
